Definition: properly, to flinch, i.e. (by implication) to go back, literally (to retreat) or figuratively (to apostatize)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to move, go, turn back, move away, backslide; 1a) (Qal) to backslide, prove recreant to; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to turn oneself away, turn back; 1b2) to be turned or driven back, be repulsed
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
